scope: Launchpad categories share the available width, and the floating view has a 16 px top inset.

checks.command: Install the candidate in disposable KDE neon Plasma 6.8.1 Wayland guests. Open floating search, capture the category strip in both editions and appearances, exercise typing and dismissal, and open the integrated view. KWin measured a 1028 by 634 logical pixel Apps panel in all four captures.

coverage_limits: Rendered checks cover both editions on KDE neon Wayland at 2x display scale.
